topics.title: On solvability of linear systems generated by the complex variable boundary element method
topics.journal: Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics
topics.summary: This paper studies linear systems arising in the complex variable boundary element method. The approximate solution is represented by a Cauchy-type integral with piecewise linear density, and the choice of representation is shown to influence the solvability properties of the discretized system. A formulation is presented that makes it possible to derive solvability results, illustrated on the Dirichlet problem.
topics.keyContribution: The paper shows how a suitable representation of the Cauchy-type integral can be used to derive solvability results for discretized systems in the complex variable boundary element method.

topics.title: On estimate for the modulus of continuity of the Cauchy-type integral having a Lipschitz-continuous density
topics.summary: This paper studies boundary behaviour of the Cauchy-type integral with Lipschitz-continuous density in domains bounded by piecewise smooth curves. An estimate for the modulus of continuity of boundary values is derived, including a parameter-dependent formulation. The result is complemented by a computational approach and illustrated on representative examples.
topics.keyContribution: The paper derives an estimate for the modulus of continuity of boundary values of a Cauchy-type integral with Lipschitz-continuous density and complements the theoretical result with a computational procedure.

topics.title: Approximations by the Cauchy-type integrals with piecewise linear densities
topics.summary: This paper contributes to the complex variable boundary element method for Jordan regions with piecewise regular boundaries without cusps. It shows that a Cauchy-type integral with a sufficiently regular density can be uniformly approximated by a Cauchy-type integral whose density is given by a piecewise linear interpolant, provided that the interpolation mesh is fine enough and uniform. The result supports the existence of approximate CVBEM solutions for planar boundary value problems, especially Dirichlet problems.
topics.keyContribution: The paper proves uniform approximation of Cauchy-type integrals by piecewise-linearly interpolated densities and thereby provides theoretical support for approximate solutions in the complex variable boundary element method.
